## 中文原文
下班回家，你准备给宝宝冲奶粉。先烧开水，等水温降到合适温度，结果发现奶粉罐快空了，只剩下一点点，不够冲一瓶奶。

## My translation
I got home from work and was about to prepare formula milk for my baby.
I boiled the water first, then when it cooled down to a proper temperature, I found the formula jar was almost empty.
The left milk power was not enough for making a bottle of milk.

## Revised version
I got home from work and was about to make formula for my baby.
I boiled some water and waited for it to cool to the right temperature.
Then I noticed the formula jar was nearly empty.
There wasn't enough powder left to mix a bottle.

## Key phrases
- make a formula 冲奶粉
- right temperature
- nearly empty，比almost稍微多一点的感觉
- mix a bottle 冲一瓶奶
